verdict.rationale: Clerk ships an official CLI, confirmed by the probe at clerk.com/cli. The CLI page shows it detects your framework and scaffolds auth files, relays webhooks locally, generates debug sign-in URLs, handles production deploy/DNS/OAuth setup, and connects the Clerk MCP server to AI clients in one command. Clerk's llms.txt also points agents to install the CLI with no API keys or sign-in required, which fits the AI-native framing well. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and a detailed first-party command reference (for example, non-interactive or machine-readable output modes for agents).
